description: This file is a Lua source code file designed for testing the UTF-8 library functionalities such as length calculation, offset determination, character encoding and decoding, and error handling. It contains test cases, assertions, and function definitions aimed at verifying the correctness of UTF-8 string processing.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Function to execute another function and assert that it raises an error containing a specific message.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string in terms of the number of characters, ignoring UTF-8 continuation bytes.

methods.name: checksyntax
methods.description: Creates a string representation of Unicode codepoints and verifies that it reconstructs the original string via load and execution.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a series of validation tests on a UTF-8 string, including length, offset, character conversion, syntax, and codepoint iteration.
